svg.text: Unpaved main roads: designs side by side, every level (Paved, Car friendly, Unpaved, 4WD)

High vis 2 colours and widths. Now = brown band with a thick dark edge; a = no edge; b = marks in a darker shade of the class colour; c = pale band; A 50 = tinted fill with a brown casing (dropped: casing changes are hard to see). 4WD near black in all.
